label: Velocity V2 OLT
description: DZS Velocity V2 compact chassis OLT (2RU, ETSI EN 300 hardened): 2 multi-service subscriber slots plus 2 management/network-facing slots, scaling to 32 GPON/XGS-PON ports. This spec counts one V2-LC-NGPC16-5 any-PON service card - 16 SFP+ ports (gpon1/1-16) that each run GPON, XGS-PON or combo PON - together with that card's 2x 100GE QSFP28 on-board uplinks and 1 management port.
